verdict.rationale: dlt has a documented MCP server (dlt-probe-4, dlt-docs-72, dlt-docs-47) that exposes tools for inspecting, debugging, and managing pipelines, secrets, schemas, and runs, plus CLI/web UI monitoring for pipeline health and diagnosing failures (dlt-docs-15). However, evidence does not explicitly confirm the MCP server or API exposes a distinct 're-trigger a failed run' action or an explicit sync-status check tool by name, and there's no independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server's diagnose+re-trigger workflow in practice. missing for 10: explicit documentation/example of the MCP server or API re-triggering a failed run, explicit 'check sync status' tool naming, and independent hands-on confirmation of the diagnose-and-retrigger loop working end-to-end.
